# BUG-001 — MemoryRegistrationRepository returns internal references instead of isolated copies

**Service:** registration-service
**Type:** implementation bug (the spec is correct, the code was not)
**Requirement violated:** REQ-REG-F13-AC4 (identical behaviour across the memory/json/sqlite backends) and REQ-REG-F10-AC5 (stored fields are read-only / immutable from the caller''s point of view)

## Found by

Exploratory testing during the bug-workflow investigation (T-18). The `json` and
`sqlite` backends return isolated copies of each record (deepcopy / freshly built
rows), while the `memory` backend returned the internal `dict` object.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Create a registration through `MemoryRegistrationRepository`.
2. Call `get()`, `list_all()`, `create_if_allowed()` or `set_status()` and mutate a
   field of the returned dict (e.g. set `status = "HACKED"`, `amount = -999`).
3. Read the record again from the repository.

## Expected behaviour

Mutating a record returned by the repository MUST NOT change the stored state — the
same guarantee the json/sqlite backends already provide.

## Actual behaviour (before fix)

The memory backend returned the same dict stored internally, so an external mutation
silently corrupted the store. Behaviour diverged from the other two backends,
breaking the cross-backend equivalence guarantee.

## Root cause

In `app/backends/memory.py` the methods returned the direct reference
(`return record` / `results.append(record)` / `self._data.get(...)`) without copying,
unlike `JsonRegistrationRepository` which uses `copy.deepcopy`.

## Fix

Return isolated copies (`copy.deepcopy`) from `create_if_allowed`, `get`, `list_all`
and `set_status` in `app/backends/memory.py`.

## Regression tests (fail before the fix, pass after)

`services/registration-service/tests/unit/test_regression_bugs.py`
- `test_memory_get_returns_isolated_copy`
- `test_memory_create_returns_isolated_copy`
- `test_memory_list_all_returns_isolated_copies`
- `test_memory_set_status_returns_isolated_copy`

## Fix commit

`a418e86` — `fix(registration): isolate memory backend records via deepcopy [T-18]`
